summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the Zydelig (idelalisib) NDA 206545. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and the Office Director memo both state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant public health questions, and the Medical Review confirms it was not taken to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee. Consequently there is no AdComm vote or AdComm-driven change to the approval; safety measures such as the boxed warning and REMS communication plan arose from FDA's own review, not from an advisory committee.
